svg.aria-label: Start C4 + E4, end B3 + E4. The lower voice moves from C4 to B3. The upper voice holds E4. Oblique motion: one voice holds while the other moves.
svg.title: Change 2: only the lower voice falls

g.text: How to read this graphic: The dashed circle
on C4 is where the lower voice began; the
arrow takes it left to B3. The square on E4
stays. The keyboard starts at B3, so the new
low note is on the picture.
